responsibility: Detects Graphite candidate Static Control Parts (SCoPs) from the current function’s CFG and loop tree. It finds SESE regions suitable for polyhedral treatment, gathers their basic blocks in execution order, records enclosing conditions and case information, extracts data references into gimple_poly_bb structures, builds alias-set groupings for memory references, and filters regions against Graphite constraints such as loop presence, array-count limits, and parameter-count limits. The result is a vector of scop objects that describe which parts of GIMPLE are eligible to be converted into the polyhedral subsystem.
